name: duo-diff-edit
description: Write together with an agent through the git index: a skill for proposing edits into the index, and a band of 📖 buttons above the prompt that open the index ↔ buffer diff of files from the last answer (needs the Duo Diff Edit extension for Visual Studio Code).

skill.title: Skill a 📖 click starts
skill.description: The skill every 📖 click starts with the file's path, as typed after the slash (duo-diff-edit:duo-diff-edit, or your own, whose frontmatter sets model and effort), besides opening the diff. Empty: the click only opens the diff. How to set it and build your own: the duo-diff-edit skill, section Configure.
